configurePresets.name: host
configurePresets.description: Host configuration: builds camera/c_api/config.c, camera/c_api/lease.c and camera/error.cpp and writes build/compile_commands.json for clangd. K230 data-plane sources are only built by the cross preset.

configurePresets.name: cross
configurePresets.description: K230 cross build. Requires a riscv64-unknown-linux-musl toolchain: export K230_TOOLCHAIN_DIR=/path/to/bin before configuring, otherwise the toolchain file fails with an explicit error.
